label: Shared clock
mechanism: Replace the reviewed global wrapper; retain one device handle and read its clock live on every call.
reason: Avoid repeatedly constructing/requesting the device wrapper.
review: Global scope. Device lifetime assumptions matter; time values are read live. Anti-Lag anomaly upvalues are untouched.

label: Markers
mechanism: Wrap the marker precheck; replace hover-direction calculation when a retained device is available.
reason: Suppress duplicate checks and move simple visible dots between full semantic checks, reusing vectors.
review: Full checks follow marker intervals. World positions can be stale between them; rich labels, pickup animations and custom end callbacks use the original pipeline. Check moving objects, hover, pickups, camera turns and PDA transitions.

label: Injury display
mechanism: Replace the private HUDUpdate upvalue with a throttling wrapper.
reason: Avoid redrawing the limb display on every actor update.
review: Display can lag by the configured interval (33 ms default). Health logic in actor_on_update still runs. Check healing previews and limb display transitions.

label: Ledge rays
mechanism: Wrap the ledge callback, replace its dgr upvalue with a constructor proxy, and swap its actor callback registry entry at the original priority.
reason: Reuse sequential rays within one synchronous ledge check; produce only the result fields that the reviewed consumer reads.
review: Ledge movement is gameplay-sensitive. Scope must not escape or survive a check. Unknown arguments fall back to the original constructor. Common Anti-Lag variants fail the source guard and skip this component.

label: Callback cache
mechanism: Replace the dispatcher with a cached initial heap and reusable per-recursion traversal arrays.
reason: Avoid rebuilding ordering and temporary buffers for unchanged callback registries.
review: Priorities remain live during traversal; equal/non-numeric priorities and metatables fall back. Callback mutation, re-entry and errors are important regression cases. This is shared execution infrastructure.

label: Ray query inputs
mechanism: Wrap the public getter; retain the original visualization path.
reason: Remove copied input vectors while retaining an independently allocated endpoint and result table.
review: Assumes native setters copy their inputs. Queries still run. Check old results are not mutated by later queries, contact offsets and visualized rays.

label: Light scans
mechanism: Reuse the synchronous visit callback while scanning live each call.
review: No cached decisions; body matching, re-entry fallback and error recovery; synchronous iterator required.

label: Offline peer panel
mechanism: Add an actor_on_update poller; do not replace the Update method in this component.
reason: Remove the offline party HUD from render updates, restoring it when a session appears.
review: Session changes are polled every 500 ms. Calls AddDialogToRender/RemoveDialogToRender and forced Update; this is not just a numeric cache. Test connect/disconnect and HUD recreation. No multiplayer engine: skip.

label: Peer field cache
mechanism: Replace the party-panel Update method; recreate an existing HUD; register an option-change cache reset.
reason: Skip unchanged widget writes, cache portraits and avoid hidden distance calculations.
review: Keeps the original 500 ms interval. Portrait cache keys are faction/outfit. Other addons modifying widgets or portrait dependencies may invalidate assumptions. Real connected co-op needs more coverage.

label: Artifact metadata
mechanism: Wrap SYS_GetParam in the artifact function environment only; register load/option-change cache resets.
reason: Cache static artifact kind metadata by section and nil/empty default separately.
review: Other parameter queries fall through. Runtime metadata edits outside the reset callbacks can be stale; global SYS_GetParam is not replaced.

label: Item update
mechanism: Replace the binder update with a reviewed shortcut; keep first-update behavior on the original.
reason: Retain object identity and reduce unused bookkeeping. Share tracked state cells where supported.
review: Native binder update still runs every call. Uses/condition remain live. If tracked state cannot be shared, tracked items use the original path. Check reloads, multiuse items, condition changes and object lifetime assumptions.

label: Artifact update
mechanism: Replace the reviewed zz_item_artefact update body in its original environment.
reason: Retain identity, reuse condition reads, skip unnecessary radiation casts and distance work for parented artifacts.
review: The replacement retains randomization, save restoration, physics and radiation branches. Check transitions, changing condition, fixed bones and radiation. No_rad keeps the original permanent-exclusion assumption.

label: Projection
mechanism: Replace projection and eye-direction helpers with private input scratch vectors.
reason: Avoid fresh input vectors for synchronous projection and direction calculations.
review: Projection output is still engine-owned; camera values remain live. Assumes synchronous calls and no retained scratch reference. Test nested/custom consumers before extending this reuse.

label: Radiation
mechanism: Replace the radiation addon wrapper while continuing to call its saved base HUD Update.
review: Normal refresh and radiation calculations remain. Private pass/slot state is initialized from the reviewed wrapper. Check gasmask slot changes, geiger requirements and competing text writers.

label: Task checks
mechanism: Replace both reviewed task status methods with versions retaining a device wrapper.
review: Actor, precache_frame, forced status and last status are read live. Task decisions are intended to match the original. Check forced complete/fail and missing tasks.

label: Vision world light
mechanism: Wrap the shared world-light helper with an engine-frame cache.
reason: Avoid recalculating the same shared lighting value for each visibility query.
review: A second lighting change within the same engine frame is not observed until the next frame. NPC-specific get_visible_value still executes. When editing this cache, check detection during lighting transitions.

label: Visibility read reduction
mechanism: Match executable body, then select the corresponding formula variant and preserve private state.
reason: Skip flashlight lookups whose results cannot be used by the current branch.
review: Recognized Stealth Crash Fix and Atmospherics variants only; unsupported bodies skip.

label: Device read reduction
mechanism: Replace the reviewed device update body with shared original upvalue cells.
reason: Retain device identity and section while reading power/condition and parent live.
review: Power, NVG, emission and PDA branches remain. 60 simulated comparisons matched. Object identity lifetime and compatibility with other binder overrides still require review.

label: Lamp save buffers
mechanism: Wrap save_data; reuse one input table per lamp; call original if the manager function changes.
reason: Avoid one temporary condition table per lamp save.
review: Every condition write still happens. The reviewed manager copies fields synchronously. A manager that retains the table would invalidate reuse; the signature guard and runtime function check are important.
